prompt.project_info: Create a natural candid lifestyle moment in a quiet park or countryside lawn.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with natural copper-red hair, fair skin, soft round facial features, green eyes, and a slight asymmetrical genuine smile, wearing a comfortable slightly loose floral summer dress.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium close-up from slightly above eye level, seated casually on a blanket or grass, shoulders relaxed, upper body leaning slightly forward, hands resting loosely on legs, soft green grass and trees behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft afternoon natural daylight with even gentle shadows, visible skin texture, calm everyday outdoor mood, no staged influencer polish.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 realistic candid photography, conversational distance, mild background blur, natural proportions, minimal retouching and authentic smartphone texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A natural candid 9:16 lifestyle photograph of an approved adult woman with natural copper-red hair, fair skin, soft round facial features, green eyes, and a slight asymmetrical genuine smile with one eye gently squinting. She sits casually on a blanket or grass in a quiet park or countryside lawn, shoulders relaxed, upper body leaning slightly forward, hands resting loosely on her legs, wearing a comfortable slightly loose floral summer dress. Soft green grass and trees fill the background. Use slightly above eye-level framing at conversational distance, soft afternoon daylight, even gentle shadows, mild background blur, raw natural photography, visible skin texture, minimal retouching, and no beauty filter.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, forced sexy expression, model pose, beauty filter, perfect symmetry, glossy lighting, selfie distortion, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
